title: Settings
description: Your brand, languages, search defaults and where photos and videos are stored.

general.brandDescription: Shown across the whole site, in emails, terms and contracts: everywhere the text says {token}. Change it here and it changes everywhere.
general.languageDescription: The site’s own language: its pages have no language in their address (for example /workshops); the other languages add theirs in front. Emails also use it when someone’s language isn’t known. Changing it changes every page’s address, and search engines take weeks to learn the new ones, so choose it once, with care.
general.seoDescription: The home page’s title and description in Google’s results and when a link to it is shared. Write the title in full, with the brand’s name; the other pages have their own title and description.
general.seoPageDescriptionHint: One or two sentences, around 150–160 characters. With the Classic template it is also the sentence under the brand on the home page.

email.providerDescription: Welcome, verification, invitation, contract and registration emails all go out this way.

resend.title: Resend
resend.hint: An email service; the easiest way to land in the inbox.

smtp.title: SMTP server
smtp.hint: Your own mail server, or a service such as Brevo or Gmail.

email.serverNote: Nothing is saved on this page yet, so the key set on the server (RESEND_API_KEY) is used, if there is one. Saving here takes over.
email.senderDescription: The name shown as the sender is always the brand name.
email.resendDescription: In Resend, add and verify your domain (it gives you DNS records for SPF and DKIM), then create an API key with “Sending access”.
email.smtpDescription: The details from your mail server or email service.
email.smtpNote: For emails to land in the inbox, the domain needs SPF, DKIM and DMARC records for this server, and the server’s IP address a matching reverse DNS (PTR) name.

hints.fromAddress: An address on a domain verified with your provider, e.g. hello@example.com.
hints.replyTo: Optional. Where replies go; empty means the sender address.
hints.resendKey: Starts with re_. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
hints.resendKeyServer: Optional: the server already has a key (RESEND_API_KEY). Enter one here to use another.
hints.smtpHost: e.g. smtp.example.com, or the name of a mail container on this server.
hints.smtpUser: Usually the full email address. Leave empty for a server that needs no sign-in.

test.sent: Test email sent to {email}. Check the inbox (and the spam folder).
test.failed: The test email couldn’t be sent: {error}

testEmail.subject: {brand}: test email
testEmail.text: Hello! This test email from {brand} was sent with {provider}. If you can read it, emails work.

errors.resendKey: A Resend API key starts with re_.
errors.host: Enter a server name like smtp.example.com.

storage.providerDescription: Photos, videos and the watermark logo are stored as files on a CDN, which delivers them quickly. Each file gets a name nobody can guess.

bunny.title: Bunny CDN
bunny.hint: Bunny Storage with a pull zone.

storage.switchWarning: Files that are already uploaded stay where they are now; they aren’t moved. Change this before uploading, or move the files yourself.
storage.localNote: Files are kept in the .data folder on this server. That’s fine for development, but for the live website choose Bunny or Cloudflare, so files are fast and survive a new deployment.
storage.bunnyDescription: You’ll find these in the Bunny dashboard, under Storage: one storage zone, with a pull zone connected to it.
storage.cloudflareDescription: You’ll find these in the Cloudflare dashboard, under R2: one bucket, with a custom domain connected to it.

hints.storageHost: Choose the main region you picked when you created the storage zone. You’ll find it in Bunny, on the storage zone’s FTP & API Access page.
hints.bunnyKey: Storage zone → FTP & API Access → Password.
hints.bunnyHost: The hostname of the pull zone connected to this storage zone, for example cdn.example.com.
hints.accountId: The 32-character ID on the R2 overview page.
hints.r2Keys: Create an R2 API token with read and write access to this bucket.
hints.r2Host: The custom domain connected to the bucket, for example cdn.example.com.

test.ok: Connected. Files can be saved, read and deleted.
test.config: The saved keys couldn’t be read. Please enter them again.
test.write: A test file couldn’t be saved. Please check the name and the key.
test.read: A test file was saved but couldn’t be read back. Please check the key’s permissions.
test.url: Files are saved, but they don’t open from the CDN hostname. Please check the hostname.
test.delete: A test file couldn’t be deleted. Please check that the key is allowed to delete files.

errors.host: Please enter a hostname, like cdn.example.com (without https://).
errors.bunnyHost: Please choose the region of your storage zone.
errors.bucket: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
errors.accountId: The account ID is 32 characters long, using the digits 0–9 and the letters a–f.
errors.keyRequired: Please paste the key. It’s stored encrypted and never shown again.

watermark.logoDescription: Your logo is added to every gallery photo when it’s uploaded. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.
watermark.noLogo: Add a logo: gallery photos can’t be uploaded until there is one.
watermark.placementDescription: Watch the preview while you adjust.
watermark.sizeHint: The logo’s width, as a share of the photo’s width.
watermark.marginHint: Space from the edge of the photo (between logos when repeated).
watermark.previewAlt: A sample photo with the watermark
watermark.previewNoLogo: Add a logo to see the preview.
watermark.previewCaption: A sample photo with your current choices.
watermark.previewUnsaved: Showing changes you haven’t saved yet.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.description: Who did what in the admin panel, and when. Entries can’t be changed or deleted.

empty.title: No activity yet
empty.description: Every change made in the admin panel will be listed here.

auth.password_reset: Password reset with an email link

instructor.profile_update: Profile edited in the instructor panel

payments.intro: Choose how students can pay. After registering, they see the ways you switch on here. When the money arrives, record it in the workshop’s Registrations tab: the registration is marked as paid.
payments.lastOne: At least one way must stay on.

cash.title: Cash at the workshop
cash.description: Students pay in cash on the day of the workshop.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.description: Students send the money to this account and write the participant’s name in the description.
transfer.holderHint: Exactly as the bank has it.
transfer.ibanHint: TR followed by 24 digits. Spaces are fine.
transfer.notePlaceholder: e.g. Please send it within two days of registering.

online.title: Online payment link
online.description: Students pay by card on the workshop’s own payment page.
online.howTo: Each workshop gets its own payment link: create it in the iyzico (iyziLink) or PayTR app for the workshop’s price and paste it into the workshop form. After someone pays, record the payment as “Online”.
online.later: Automatic confirmation (a full iyzico or PayTR integration) needs a business account and will come later.
online.notePlaceholder: e.g. You’ll get a receipt from iyzico by email.

preview.title: What students see
preview.description: After registering for a workshop of {amount}, in your language.
preview.unsaved: Showing changes you haven’t saved yet.
preview.onlineHint: The “Pay online” button appears only for workshops that have a payment link.

errors.oneWay: Please keep at least one way to pay switched on.
errors.holderRequired: Please write the account holder’s name.
errors.ibanCountry: The IBAN should start with TR.
errors.ibanLength: A Turkish IBAN is TR followed by 24 digits. Please check it.
errors.ibanChecksum: This IBAN doesn’t add up: a digit may be mistyped. Please check it.

reset.title: Delete all transactions and reset
reset.description: To start again with clean books, e.g. after trying the site out. The wallet and every account go back to zero.

removed.transactions: {count, plural, =0 {No wallet transactions} one {The wallet's only transaction} other {All {n} wallet transactions (capital, expenses, advances, registration payments and refunds, workshop closings)}}
removed.contracts: {count, plural, =0 {No contracts to delete} one {{n} contract not signed or of a workshop not held} other {{n} contracts not signed or of workshops not held}}
removed.audit: {count, plural, =0 {No money rows in the activity log} one {{n} money row of the activity log} other {{n} money rows of the activity log}}

kept.people: Every account: partners, instructors and members
kept.heldContracts: The signed contracts of workshops that took place
kept.settings: Templates, categories and every other setting

reset.irreversible: This cannot be undone. A workshop whose contract is deleted gets a new one when it is saved again.

confirm.title: Are you sure?
confirm.description: The wallet's transactions and the contracts above are deleted for good. To go on, type the phrase below and your password.

danger.done: All transactions are deleted; the wallet is at zero.

errors.phrase: Type the phrase exactly as shown.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes.

spender.title: Paying costs
spender.description: Only one partner pays and records costs from the shared wallet: general and workshop expenses, instructors' advances and fees. The other partners can see them.
spender.label: Who pays the costs?

withdrawals.title: Partners' withdrawals
withdrawals.description: Partners taking money out of the shared wallet for themselves. Closed for now.
withdrawals.label: Allow withdrawals from the shared wallet
withdrawals.hint: While this is off, no partner can record a withdrawal and the Withdraw button is hidden.

errors.spender: Choose one of the active partners.
